name: 🔦 Midnight Mystery
description:
Murder mystery with a twist! One Murderer, one Sheriff, everyone else Innocent. Collect coins, HIDE in closets, SLAM doors and survive - or find the Murderer before it's too late.

🌙 30+ new features: secret vents, glue traps, Shadow and Dash for the Murderer, Scanner footprints for the Sheriff, power-up boxes, blackout rounds, ghost guesses, battle pass, daily quests, skin forge, pets and titles.
🔪 50+ knives, blasters, pets and KO effects. Every crate shows its odds - or buy skins directly with coins.
🤖 Bots fill small servers so you can play right away.

Cartoon knockouts, no blood.
